query: Marvell Technology data center revenue Q3 fiscal 2026 custom AI silicon and electro-optics
normalized: 2026 ai center custom data electro fiscal marvell optics q3 revenue silicon technology

output.content:
Marvell generated **$1.518 billion of data-center revenue in Q3 fiscal 2026** (three months ended **November 1, 2025**), up **38% year over year** from $1.101 billion and **2% sequentially** from $1.491 billion. [[1]] 

Data center represented **73% of Marvell’s $2.075 billion total Q3 revenue**, making it the company’s dominant end market. [[1]] 

The quarterly increase was approximately **$27.4 million sequentially**, while the year-over-year increase was approximately **$416.8 million**, based on Marvell’s reported end-market revenue figures. [[1]] 

Marvell does **not** disclose separate Q3 revenue amounts for **custom AI silicon** versus **electro-optics**; it reports their contribution within the aggregate data-center end market rather than as standalone product-revenue lines. [[1]] 

Management had identified strong AI demand for both custom silicon and electro-optics as a key growth driver entering Q3, and stated that custom-AI design activity had reached an all-time high, with more than 50 opportunities across over 10 customers. [[2]] 

Total Q3 revenue of **$2.075 billion** exceeded the midpoint of Marvell’s prior **$2.060 billion ±5%** guidance by **$15 million**, while the company guided Q4 fiscal 2026 revenue to **$2.200 billion ±5%**. [[1]] [[2]] [[1]]

sources.title: Marvell Technology, Inc. Reports Third Quarter of Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
